import json, os
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql.datasource import DataSource, DataSourceReader, InputPartition
spark = SparkSession.builder.master("local[1]").config("spark.ui.enabled","false").getOrCreate()
spark.conf.set("spark.sql.python.filterPushdown.enabled","true")
out=[]
cases=[("timestamp","x = timestamp '2020-01-01 00:00:00'","UTC"),
       ("timestamp","x = timestamp '2020-01-01 00:00:00'","America/Los_Angeles"),
       ("timestamp","x = timestamp '2020-01-01 00:00:00'","Asia/Kolkata"),
       ("timestamp_ntz","x = timestamp_ntz '2020-01-01 00:00:00'","America/Los_Angeles"),
       ("date","x = date '2020-01-01'","UTC")]
for i,(t,f,tz) in enumerate(cases):
    spark.conf.set("spark.sql.session.timeZone", tz)
    seen=[]
    log=f"/work/ltz{i}.log"
    open(log,"w").close()
    class R(DataSourceReader):
        def pushFilters(self, filters):
            with open(log,"a") as fh: fh.write(repr(list(filters))+"\n")
            return filters
        def partitions(self): return [InputPartition(0)]
        def read(self,p): return iter([])
    class S(DataSource):
        @classmethod
        def name(cls): return f"ltz{i}"
        def schema(self): return f"x {t}"
        def reader(self, schema): return R()
    spark.dataSource.register(S)
    spark.read.format(f"ltz{i}").load().filter(f).count()
    out.append({"type":t,"filter":f,"session_tz":tz,"filters":open(log).read().strip().splitlines()})
json.dump(out,open("/work/ltz.json","w"),indent=1)
